name: Aroma-Zone
desc: French natural beauty and wellness brand selling skincare, haircare and essential oils online and through its own shops.
markets: France and neighbouring European countries; Eurazeo cites more than 5 million active customers
talks: Eurazeo entered exclusive talks to sell its stake to Partners Group, which would take a majority; press reports valued Aroma-Zone at about EUR 2B including debt.
raised_so_far: Eurazeo invested about EUR 410M for its majority stake in 2021, per Unquote
status_detail: Eurazeo itself announced the exclusive talks on 6 Aug 2026 and would keep a minority stake; the price was not disclosed and completion was not found. EUR 2B is about USD 2.3B.
rationale: Fast-growing French beauty brand with a new owner seeking growth abroad; F1's European audience suits a consumer brand expanding beyond France.
parent: None: owned by an investment firm (Eurazeo; Partners Group in exclusive talks to buy a majority)
